title: 2025 CWE Top 25 Most Dangerous Software Weaknesses
notes: The ids and the in-scope split are the CWE Top 25 for 2025 as the detection programme analyses them: 25 weaknesses, seven of which are memory-safety classes a black-box DAST engine cannot evidence. The vendored list makes REQ-DET-004's 18/18 claim machine-checkable; it is a coverage denominator, not a check mapping, so it lives beside the framework snapshots rather than inside the CWE vocabulary file.
